responder.title: Volunteer responder
responder.intro: Someone nearby may need help. Accept an alert to see what the person chose to share. This is a simulation: in a real emergency call 112.
responder.notVerified: Your account is waiting for an admin to verify it. You will see alerts after that.
responder.loadError: Could not load. Please try again.
responder.acceptError: Could not accept. The alert may have ended.
volunteer.title: Become a volunteer responder
volunteer.intro: Sign up, then an admin checks your account. Until then you will not receive alerts.
volunteer.name: Full name
volunteer.done: Thank you. An admin will verify your account. You can sign in after that.
volunteer.invalid: Please fill in every field. The password needs at least 8 characters.
volunteer.error: Could not sign up. Please try again.
